# Random name picker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/random-picker/

Select one or more entries from a list using secure browser randomness. Duplicate entries are removed and picks are made without replacement.

## How to use it

1. Choose or enter the content for this tool.
2. Start the action with the settings you want.
3. Review the result before copying, sharing or continuing.

## Example

Choose three unique participants from a class list or pick the next task from your backlog.

## Limits and checks

Each unique line is one entry. This is a simple local selection tool rather than an audited competition platform.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
